content:
{'translation': "Choosing between the AirPods 4 and AirPods Pro 3 basically comes down to your preferences for fit, features, and price. Apple is indeed developing AirPods equipped with cameras and Visual Intelligence, but they aren't expected to launch until at least 2027. Waiting that long could end up being a very long wait.", 'language': '繁體中文（香港）'}

{'translation': 'AirPods 4 go for comfort and value, with multiple models to choose from', 'language': '繁體中文（香港）'}

{'translation': "The AirPods 4 feature an open design, making them highly recommended if you don't like ear tips. Our AirPods 4 review found that the redesigned shape is comfortable to wear without sacrificing everyday convenience.", 'language': '繁體中文（香港）'}

{'translation': 'The $129 model comes with the Apple H2 chip and Personalized Spatial Audio, offering up to five hours of listening time. However, it lacks Active Noise Cancellation (ANC), Transparency mode, and wireless charging.', 'language': '繁體中文（香港）'}

{'translation': 'The $179 model adds practical Active Noise Cancellation without blocking the ear canal, along with Adaptive Audio, Transparency mode, and a wireless charging case with a built-in Find My speaker.', 'language': '繁體中文（香港）'}

{'translation': 'Because the open design lets in more ambient noise, its Active Noise Cancellation performance will be compromised on planes or public transport.', 'language': '繁體中文（香港）'}

{'translation': 'AirPods Pro 3 offer a complete set of features', 'language': '繁體中文（香港）'}

{'translation': 'The AirPods Pro 3 are priced at $249 from Apple, and Amazon frequently offers discounts. Their foam-tipped ear tips deliver stronger bass and noticeably better Active Noise Cancellation. Apple officially claims up to eight hours of listening time with ANC on, compared to just four hours for the AirPods 4 with ANC enabled.', 'language': '繁體中文（香港）'}

{'translation': "They can measure heart rate during workouts and support Apple's hearing test, hearing aid, and hearing protection features. Our AirPods Pro 3 review found that their workout heart rate readings were largely consistent with Apple Watch data.", 'language': '繁體中文（香港）'}

{'translation': 'Additionally, iOS 27 brings custom EQ to both models, while the AirPods Pro 3 gains extra advantages thanks to its heart rate sensor and new charging case.', 'language': '繁體中文（香港）'}

{'translation': 'Should you wait for AirPods with Visual Intelligence?', 'language': '繁體中文（香港）'}

{'translation': 'This week, a video hidden within the macOS Tahoe 26.7 Release Candidate leaked footage of AirPods equipped with Visual Intelligence. The clip appears to show someone using Siri to instruct camera-equipped AirPods to remember a book using Visual Intelligence. This has led to speculation that the product could launch at any time.', 'language': '繁體中文（香港）'}

{'translation': "However, follow-up reports painted a different picture. Bloomberg's Mark Gurman pointed out that AirPods with cameras are still expected to arrive in 2027. The B790 model shown in the video is reportedly a modified AirPods Pro 3 design that was previously dropped from Apple's 2026 product roadmap. Apple continues to develop a newer-generation B798.", 'language': '繁體中文（香港）'}

{'translation': 'So which AirPods should you buy?', 'language': '繁體中文（香港）'}

{'translation': "If price is your top concern and you don't need Active Noise Cancellation, go for the $129 AirPods 4. If you strongly prefer an open fit, get the AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation.", 'language': '繁體中文（香港）'}

{'translation': "For most everyone else, the AirPods Pro 3 remain the best choice, especially when discounted on Amazon to a price close to the AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation. They offer stronger noise cancellation, longer battery life, heart rate sensing, and Apple's hearing health features.", 'language': '繁體中文（香港）'}

{'translation': 'AirPods prices today', 'language': '繁體中文（香港）'}

  • {'translation': 'AirPods 4 ($99, original price $129)', 'language': '繁體中文（香港）'}
  • {'translation': 'AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation ($148.99, original price $179)', 'language': '繁體中文（香港）'}
  • {'translation': 'AirPods Pro 3 ($189.99, original price $249)', 'language': '繁體中文（香港）'}

{'translation': "Unless Visual Intelligence is absolutely essential for you, waiting may not be worth it. If you need new earphones now, waiting over a year won't get you practical benefits like better Active Noise Cancellation or longer battery life—just an unconfirmed feature.", 'language': '繁體中文（香港）'}

{'translation': 'Otherwise, buy based on what you need today. The current discounted AirPods already meet the practical needs of most buyers, while the future camera-equipped model will likely cost more, or be priced very close to retail at launch.', 'language': '繁體中文（香港）'}

{'translation': 'Get the most out of your Apple products', 'language': '繁體中文（香港）'}
